target_customer: Data engineering and platform teams that need to see how schema changes affect downstream models, APIs and dashboards
problem: Database and schema changes break machine learning models, APIs and dashboards because relationships across systems are not tracked.
business_model: Open source core with a planned cloud-hosted paid offering
product_category: Open source data lineage and metadata version control

founders.name: Ian Eaves
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him under Former Founders; says ex-physicist turned ML engineer, built ML teams at Bellhops and Centene, wrote the Visions library. Education not stated.

technical_complexity.rationale: Building connectors across databases, dbt and BI tools and a graph model of dependencies is standard data engineering with many integrations.

defensibility.rationale: Open source code with MIT-style licensing is easy to copy; value depends on connector breadth and community.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No dated source found on incumbent reaction.

market_need_then: The YC launch post describes tracking data after it leaves production; no spend or complaint data found.

branding.domain_note: Uses grai.io; no purchase history found.

brand_strength.rationale: A different company named GRAI (AI music, raised $9M in 2026) shares the name, which creates search confusion; no brand evidence for this Grai was found.

outcome_analysis: The cause of the inactive status is not public: no shutdown post, post-mortem or press report was found. Grai built an open source lineage product during YC S22 and the YC page now lists it as inactive and the founder as former, but the docs and repository still look live. No funding was found, so the data cannot say whether it failed to raise or stopped by choice.
